description: This Java class defines a custom Akka Streams GraphStage called Transistor, which models a flow regulator controlled by credits arriving via a side channel. It manages inflow and outflow elements with strict control over the number of elements in transit, mimicking the behavior of a bipolar junction transistor.

classes.name: Transistor
classes.description: A custom Akka Streams GraphStage that models a transistor-like flow regulator, controlling data flow based on received credits and demand signals.

classes.name: TransistorLogic
classes.description: Inner class extending GraphStageLogicWithLogging, implementing the core logic for managing element flow, credits, and demand within the Transistor stage.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of Transistor.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the graph stage, defining its inlets and outlets.

methods.name: createLogic
methods.description: Creates the logic (TransistorLogic) that implements the stage's behavior.
